verdict.rationale: Sketch docs say developers, managers, and stakeholders can view, inspect, and comment on designs in the web app, and can add comments from iPhone/iPad. That covers commenting directly in the file. Nothing in the pack shows @mentioning teammates or resolving comment threads. Missing for 10: evidence of @mentions in comments, evidence of resolving or closing threads, any in-depth commenting docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
